page_title: GIR 1-0 PAL | Girona v Las Palmas 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' 1 - 0 GOAL! Portu (Girona) scores with a header from close range after Yan Couto headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:0.
86' Here is a change. Jonathan Viera is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Enzo Loiodice cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Yan Couto (Girona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
85' Yan Couto (Girona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Portu (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alvaro Valles is quickest to intercept the ball.
82' A quickly taken corner by Las Palmas.
81' Good defending. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) tries to find Maximo Perrone inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Las Palmas win a corner.

79' Ivan Martin (Girona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alvaro Valles pulls off an easy save.
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
77' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ivan Martin (Girona) brought his opponent down. Las Palmas are awarded the free kick.
76' Substitution. Marc Cardona Rovira (Las Palmas) has come on for Munir El Haddadi.
75' Michel prepares a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov is replaced by Portu (Girona).
72' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) heads on.
72' Substitution. Savio leaves the pitch and is replaced by Valery (Girona).
69' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Yan Couto (Girona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
67' David Lopez (Girona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
67' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by David Lopez (Girona).
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:8. Shots on target – 3:4.
65' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
64' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yangel Herrera departs the field of play to be replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
62' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Artem Dovbyk (Girona) replacing Cristhian Stuani.
61' Arnau Martinez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
60' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
58' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is replacing Pejino.
56' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Kirian and he is replaced by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas).
55' Pejino (Las Palmas) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Paulo Gazzaniga, who makes a comfortable save.
52' That looked a certain handball by Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
50' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

50' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' What was Kirian (Las Palmas) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
48' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
46' The whistle blows and Mateo Busquets Ferrer starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Savio (Girona) commits a foul and Mateo Busquets Ferrer immediately signals a free kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
43' Girona have a corner.
43' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Pejino (Las Palmas) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
38' The ball is laid off to Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Alvaro Valles to make a decent save.
35' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
35' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' The goal by Girona won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
31' Wait! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer has indicated he is going to review the Girona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
30' Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) puts the ball into his own net.
26' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
24' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is alert and thwarts the effort.
23' Savio (Girona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
22' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
21' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
17' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
15' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
13' Arnau Martinez (Girona) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
12' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

11' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Alvaro Valles anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
7' Savio (Girona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
4' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.

3' Excellent touch by Pejino (Las Palmas)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
1' The match has just started.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Mateo Busquets Ferrer.
